analyticsMetricSessionsDesc: A session in Google Analytics is a period of time in which a user interacts with your website.
analyticsMetricAvgDurationDesc: Session duration is the time frame during which there are users interactions occurring on the website.
analyticsMetricBounceRateDesc: Bounce rate is the percentage of people who land on a page and leave without performing a specific action.
analyticsMetricConversionsDesc: A conversion is a user action that you count because you consider it important, such as a purchase, game level completion, or website or app scroll activity.
analyticsMetricViewsDesc: A pageview is defined as a view of a page on your site that is being tracked by the Analytics tracking code. If a user clicks reload after reaching the page or navigates to a different page and then returns to the original page, then this is counted as an additional page view.
analyticsMetricAvgEngagementDesc: Average engagement time is the average time that your website was in focus in a user's browser or a mobile app was in the foreground on a user's device.
analyticsNewUsersDesc: New users are users who have never visited your website or app before
analyticsReturningUsersDesc: Returning users are users who have never visited your website or app before
